title: Strong NIR-II Magneto-Optical Activity of a Chiral Sm15Cu54 Cage

synthesis.procedure: Dissolve copper(II) acetate monohydrate and samarium(III) chloride hexahydrate in ethanol. Add the ethanolic R-H2L solution, then add triethylamine solution slowly dropwise. Stir at room temperature for 2 h and filter into a 25 mL beaker. Seal with parafilm, make a venting hole, and leave standing for one week to obtain blue-green plate-like crystals.

reagents.name: R-H2L
reagents.amount: 4 mL of 0.1 mol L−1 ethanolic solution (0.4 mmol)

solvents: ethanol (6 mL for the metal salts and 4 mL for the ligand)
synthesis.vessel_or_method: 25 mL beaker sealed with vented parafilm for crystallization
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Filtered reaction mixture; blue-green plate-like crystals formed on standing.

properties.summary: Chiroptical and magnetic circular dichroism (MCD) spectra show a strong SmIII f–f-derived NIR-II magneto-optical response. The reported maximum MCD g-factor applies to the R/S-Sm15Cu54 pair.

measurements.name: maximum MCD g-factor
measurements.conditions: approximately 1400 nm; room temperature; chloroform/dimethyl sulfoxide (1:1, v/v); MCD under an external magnetic field

source_locations.location: Supplied CCDC catalog; enantiomer resolved against SI Table S3 space group

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: A discrete triangular-prism cage comprising two Ln3Cu9 panels and three Ln3Cu12 handles linked by six chloride ions; the metal framework is helical.

synthesis.procedure: Follow the R-Sm15Cu54 preparation, replacing R-H2L with S-H2L: dissolve the metal salts in ethanol, add the ethanolic ligand and then triethylamine solution slowly dropwise, stir at room temperature for 2 h, filter into a 25 mL beaker, and leave for one week under vented parafilm to crystallize.

reagents.name: S-H2L
reagents.amount: 4 mL of 0.1 mol L−1 ethanolic solution (0.4 mmol)

solvents: ethanol (6 mL for the metal salts and 4 mL for the ligand)
synthesis.vessel_or_method: 25 mL beaker sealed with vented parafilm for crystallization
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Filtered reaction mixture; crystals formed on standing.

properties.summary: The Sm enantiomer exhibits strong NIR-II MCD associated with SmIII f–f transitions. Its measured susceptibility decreases upon cooling, and its 2 K magnetization remains unsaturated at 7 T.

measurements.name: maximum MCD g-factor
measurements.conditions: approximately 1400 nm; room temperature; reported for R/S-Sm15Cu54
